text:

Sun Devils Dominate: Beach Volleyball Duo Earns Big 12 Honors Arizona State University’s beach volleyball team is making waves.
The No. 12 Arizona State redshirt junior Ava Kirunchyk and sophomore Ava Williamson were named Big 12 Pair of the Week on April 9.
Their partnership, formed on March 26, has resulted in a nine-match winning streak.
The pair achieved a 4-0 record over the weekend, including a victory against the No. 2 pair from No. 1 TCU.
williamson holds an 18-8 record this season, while Kirunchyk sits at 17-7.
Williamson’s 18 wins are tied for the team’s best, contributing to ASU’s overall record of 17-9.
Rattlers Strike: Thrilling Victory Over Green Bay Blizzard The Arizona Rattlers, defending Indoor Football League champions, secured a dramatic 51-47 victory against the Green Bay Blizzard on Sunday, april 6, improving their record to 2-0.
Quarterback Dalton Sneed lead the charge with 269 passing yards and four touchdowns.
Sneed connected with Corey Reed Jr. for a touchdown with just one minute remaining, followed by a two-point conversion to Jamal Miles , narrowing the score to 47-44.
After a turnover on downs,Sneed completed a crucial pass to Ron Brown Jr., advancing to the Green Bay 15-yard line with eight seconds left.
With three seconds on the clock,Sneed found Miles in the end zone for a 15-yard touchdown pass,securing the lead for the Rattlers.
Sneed’s 15-yard pass to Miles in the end zone with three seconds left gave the Rattlers the lead.
The Rattlers sealed the win by defending a final desperation pass attempt in the end zone.
Looking ahead, the Rattlers are set to host the San Antonio Gunslingers (1-1) on Saturday, April 12, at 6:05 p.m. at Desert Diamond Arena.
Diamond Devils Update: ASU baseball Eyes Cincinnati Series The Arizona State baseball team holds a 22-11 record after defeating Cal State Northridge on April 8. The team is preparing for a series against Cincinnati from April 11-13.
Infielder Matt King showcased his power, hitting two home runs and driving in six runs against CSUN.
King went 4-for-5 in the game, boosting his batting average to .393.
